experiment: P3o-R MFT component separability before count extraction
research_question: Can a supervised, waveform-only separator recover enough of the exact normalized MFT component from compound I/Q that the frozen P3c inverse-filter count estimator improves on raw compound I/Q across all five regimes?
hypothesis: P3c proved count is physically sufficient on the exact MFT component. P3o-M/N/O/P/Q only tested count features directly on compound I/Q. A component separator is therefore a distinct, falsifiable information-preservation hypothesis rather than another count-token variant.

data.identity_rule: All powers and all regimes for a receiver_noise_seed remain in the same role. Train and development roles must have zero overlap with each other and every prior data receipt audited before training.

teacher_and_estimator.teacher: MFT-only signal reconstructed from finite delay_01_s..delay_08_s and amplitude_01..amplitude_08, then RMS normalized. It is available only while training/evaluating separability and is never an inference input.
teacher_and_estimator.separator: ConditionalComplexUNetSeparator(width=12, classifier_width=12, condition=false); input is per-view RMS-normalized compound I/Q; output is RMS-normalized estimated MFT component.
teacher_and_estimator.waveform_loss: 1 - complex-IQ cosine + 0.2 L1 + 0.25 multi-resolution spectral loss; no count, ordinal, classification, routing, contrast, threshold, or parameter-regression loss.
teacher_and_estimator.downstream_estimator: Frozen P3c correct-reference sparse inverse filter, delay search 0..1500, relative support threshold 0.02, clipped count 0..8; trainable_parameters=0.

optimization.role_split: per 63 label combination (33 paired identities): fit=25, selection=4, unused holdout=4; only fit updates parameters and selection chooses waveform-loss checkpoint; development is never used for checkpoint, threshold, or hyperparameter selection.

stop_rule: After opening development seed 1890000000, do not change architecture, teacher normalization, loss, estimator, split, gates, checkpoint criterion, or hyperparameters. If any gate fails, freeze P3o-R; do not use 1900M/1910M confirmation and do not attach MFT count to C2/P1n.
next_if_pass: Freeze the separator and run a two-identity confirmation before considering a predicted-label-gated end-to-end parameter integration.
